en.title: Inbox bot that trashes junk, spam & phishing
en.summary: Stand up an inbox bot for mountain-of-email days: it targets junk, spam, phishing, and more—so cleanup is a guided pass instead of endless manual sorting.
en.whyItWorks: Triage is repetitive and easy to postpone. A bot that classifies low-value and risky mail first shrinks the pile to what still needs a human read.
workflowSteps: Connect or forward mailbox access the bot is allowed to classify.
Define trash-worthy categories: junk, spam, phishing, and any extra buckets you want.
Require a review list (sender, subject, reason) before mass trash actions.
Approve batches; escalate anything that looks like a real bill, person, or account notice.
Re-run on a schedule or whenever the unread count feels overwhelming.
en.promptTemplate:
You are my inbox cleanup bot.

Classify messages into: keep, junk, spam, phishing, needs-human.
For junk/spam/phishing candidates, list sender, subject, and reason.
Never permanently delete without my batch approval.
If phishing is suspected, highlight urgency and recommended next human checks.
Do not click links or enter credentials.
en.connectorsAndRoutines: Gmail (or bot inbox forwards) plus confirm-before-delete on trash batches. Optional daily routine for a short triage digest. Phishing handling stays advisory.

setupSteps.title: Connect or forward the mailbox the bot may classify
setupSteps.detail: Connectors this case lists: Gmail, Bot inbox, and Confirm-before-delete. Gmail, or forwards into the bot inbox.

setupSteps.title: Send the prompt template on this page
setupSteps.detail: Classify each message as keep, junk, spam, phishing, or needs-human. Add any extra trash-worthy buckets you want.

setupSteps.title: Require a review list before anything is trashed
setupSteps.detail: Junk, spam, and phishing candidates list sender, subject, and reason. Nothing is permanently deleted until you approve that batch.

setupSteps.title: Escalate real mail and keep phishing advisory
setupSteps.detail: A real bill, a person, or an account notice is for you to read. Suspected phishing is highlighted with urgency and recommended human checks. The bot does not click links or enter credentials.

setupSteps.title: Re-run when the pile grows
setupSteps.detail: On a schedule, or whenever the unread count feels overwhelming. The optional daily routine returns a short triage digest.

acceptanceChecklist: Each message is classified as keep, junk, spam, phishing, or needs-human.
Junk, spam, and phishing candidates appear as a review list with sender, subject, and reason before anything is trashed.
Nothing is permanently deleted until you approve that batch.

Suspected phishing is highlighted with urgency and recommended human checks. The bot does not click links or enter credentials, and a real bill, person, or account notice is escalated for you to read.
When the optional daily routine runs, it returns a short triage digest.

zh.title: 清理垃圾/骚扰/钓鱼的收件箱 Bot
zh.summary: 为邮件堆积如山的日子搭一个收件箱 Bot：对准垃圾、骚扰、钓鱼等——清理变成有引导的批次，而不是无尽手工分类。
zh.whyItWorks: 分拣重复又容易拖延。先让 Bot 标出低价值与高风险邮件，剩下的才需要人读。
workflowSteps: 连接或转发 Bot 被允许分类的邮箱。
定义可丢弃类别：垃圾、骚扰、钓鱼，以及你想要的额外桶。
批量丢弃前要求审阅清单（发件人、主题、原因）。
按批批准；疑似真实账单、真人来信或账户通知则升级人工。
按日程重跑，或在未读数失控时再跑。
zh.promptTemplate:
你是我的收件箱清理 Bot。

将邮件分为：保留、垃圾、骚扰、钓鱼、需人工。
对垃圾/骚扰/钓鱼候选，列出发件人、主题与原因。
未经我批次批准，不得永久删除。
若疑似钓鱼，标出紧迫性与建议的人工检查。
不要点击链接或输入凭据。
zh.connectorsAndRoutines: Gmail（或 Bot 收件箱转发）+ 丢弃批次确认。可选每日例行输出短分拣摘要。钓鱼处理仅作建议。

setupSteps.title: 连接或转发 Bot 可以分类的邮箱
setupSteps.detail: 本案例列出的连接器：Gmail、Bot inbox、Confirm-before-delete。可以用 Gmail，或转发进 Bot 收件箱。

setupSteps.title: 把本页的提示词模板发出去
setupSteps.detail: 每封邮件分成：保留、垃圾、骚扰、钓鱼或需人工。你也可以再加自己的可丢弃类别。

setupSteps.title: 丢弃前先要一份审阅清单
setupSteps.detail: 垃圾、骚扰和钓鱼候选列出发件人、主题和原因。未经你按批批准，不会永久删除。

setupSteps.title: 真人邮件升级给你，钓鱼只作建议
setupSteps.detail: 看起来像真实账单、真人来信或账户通知的，交给你阅读。疑似钓鱼会标出紧迫性和建议的人工检查。Bot 不会点击链接或输入凭据。

setupSteps.title: 堆积起来时再跑一遍
setupSteps.detail: 按日程重跑，或在未读数失控时再跑。可选的每日例行会返回一份简短的分拣摘要。

acceptanceChecklist: 每封邮件会被分成：保留、垃圾、骚扰、钓鱼或需人工。
垃圾、骚扰和钓鱼候选会在丢弃前以审阅清单列出，包含发件人、主题和原因。
未经你按批批准，不会永久删除任何邮件。
疑似钓鱼会被标出紧迫性和建议的人工检查；Bot 不会点击链接或输入凭据。看起来像真实账单、真人来信或账户通知的邮件会交给你阅读。
可选的每日例行运行时，会返回一份简短的分拣摘要。
